info.title: Elevateo additive administration, outreach and scoped read API
info.description: V1 schemas unchanged. Guarded mailbox-scoped assignee options and private inbound attachment reads are active in the isolated candidate for fleet proof. Delivery, enrollment and worker status remain disabled.

get.description: Requires current mailbox assignment authority inside the protected read transaction. Eligible subjects are sorted by UUID. The opaque cursor is signed and bound to actor, organization, mailbox, session authorization version and ordering. The V1 assignment write remains final authority.
